Testing

Tests are ordinary Faber source. There is no separate test language and no external runner to configure.

A single test#

test declares one test. assert asserts.

freader locale
faber convert --to en — English reader surface
test "additio" {
    assert 1 + 1 ≡ 2
}
faber convert --to la — canonical Faber
proba "additio" {
    adfirma 1 + 1 ≡ 2
}
faber convert --to th-TH — Thai
ทดสอบ "additio" {
    ยืนยัน 1 + 1 ≡ 2
}
faber convert --to zh-Hans — Simplified Chinese
测试 "additio" {
    断言 1 + 1 ≡ 2
}
faber convert --to zh-Hant — Traditional Chinese
測試 "additio" {
    斷言 1 + 1 ≡ 2
}
faber convert --to vi — Vietnamese
kiểm_thử "additio" {
    khẳng_định 1 + 1 ≡ 2
}
faber convert --to ar — Arabic
اختبر "additio" {
    أكد 1 + 1 ≡ 2
}
faber convert --to hi — Hindi
परीक्षण "additio" {
    पुष्टि 1 + 1 ≡ 2
}

Grouping tests#

describe groups related tests under one name.

freader locale
faber convert --to en — English reader surface
describe "arithmetica" {
    test "additio" {
        assert 1 + 1 ≡ 2
    }

    test "multiplicatio" {
        assert 2 * 3 ≡ 6
    }
}
faber convert --to la — canonical Faber
probandum "arithmetica" {
    proba "additio" {
        adfirma 1 + 1 ≡ 2
    }

    proba "multiplicatio" {
        adfirma 2 * 3 ≡ 6
    }
}
faber convert --to th-TH — Thai
ทดสอบชุด "arithmetica" {
    ทดสอบ "additio" {
        ยืนยัน 1 + 1 ≡ 2
    }

    ทดสอบ "multiplicatio" {
        ยืนยัน 2 * 3 ≡ 6
    }
}
faber convert --to zh-Hans — Simplified Chinese
验题 "arithmetica" {
    测试 "additio" {
        断言 1 + 1 ≡ 2
    }

    测试 "multiplicatio" {
        断言 2 * 3 ≡ 6
    }
}
faber convert --to zh-Hant — Traditional Chinese
測試規格 "arithmetica" {
    測試 "additio" {
        斷言 1 + 1 ≡ 2
    }

    測試 "multiplicatio" {
        斷言 2 * 3 ≡ 6
    }
}
faber convert --to vi — Vietnamese
đối_tượng_kiểm_thử "arithmetica" {
    kiểm_thử "additio" {
        khẳng_định 1 + 1 ≡ 2
    }

    kiểm_thử "multiplicatio" {
        khẳng_định 2 * 3 ≡ 6
    }
}
faber convert --to ar — Arabic
مختبر "arithmetica" {
    اختبر "additio" {
        أكد 1 + 1 ≡ 2
    }

    اختبر "multiplicatio" {
        أكد 2 * 3 ≡ 6
    }
}
faber convert --to hi — Hindi
परीक्षणसमूह "arithmetica" {
    परीक्षण "additio" {
        पुष्टि 1 + 1 ≡ 2
    }

    परीक्षण "multiplicatio" {
        पुष्टि 2 * 3 ≡ 6
    }
}

Tagging#

tag labels a test so it can be selected or filtered when running.

freader locale
faber convert --to en — English reader surface
describe "textus" {
    test "concatenatio" tag "fast" {
        assert "a" + "b" ≡ "ab"
    }
}
faber convert --to la — canonical Faber
probandum "textus" {
    proba "concatenatio" tag "fast" {
        adfirma "a" + "b" ≡ "ab"
    }
}
faber convert --to th-TH — Thai
ทดสอบชุด "textus" {
    ทดสอบ "concatenatio" แท็ก "fast" {
        ยืนยัน "a" + "b" ≡ "ab"
    }
}
faber convert --to zh-Hans — Simplified Chinese
验题 "textus" {
    测试 "concatenatio" 标签 "fast" {
        断言 "a" + "b" ≡ "ab"
    }
}
faber convert --to zh-Hant — Traditional Chinese
測試規格 "textus" {
    測試 "concatenatio" 標籤 "fast" {
        斷言 "a" + "b" ≡ "ab"
    }
}
faber convert --to vi — Vietnamese
đối_tượng_kiểm_thử "textus" {
    kiểm_thử "concatenatio" nhãn "fast" {
        khẳng_định "a" + "b" ≡ "ab"
    }
}
faber convert --to ar — Arabic
مختبر "textus" {
    اختبر "concatenatio" وسم "fast" {
        أكد "a" + "b" ≡ "ab"
    }
}
faber convert --to hi — Hindi
परीक्षणसमूह "textus" {
    परीक्षण "concatenatio" टैग "fast" {
        पुष्टि "a" + "b" ≡ "ab"
    }
}

Modifiers#

Modifiers follow the test name.

freader locale
faber convert --to en — English reader surface
describe "modifiers" {
    test "stable" tag "fast" {
        assert true
    }

    test "flaky guard" repeat 3 {
        assert true
    }

    test "not written yet" todo "waiting on the parser" {
        assert true
    }
}
faber convert --to la — canonical Faber
probandum "modifiers" {
    proba "stable" tag "fast" {
        adfirma verum
    }

    proba "flaky guard" repete 3 {
        adfirma verum
    }

    proba "not written yet" futurum "waiting on the parser" {
        adfirma verum
    }
}
faber convert --to th-TH — Thai
ทดสอบชุด "modifiers" {
    ทดสอบ "stable" แท็ก "fast" {
        ยืนยัน จริง
    }

    ทดสอบ "flaky guard" ทำซ้ำ 3 {
        ยืนยัน จริง
    }

    ทดสอบ "not written yet" ค้าง "waiting on the parser" {
        ยืนยัน จริง
    }
}
faber convert --to zh-Hans — Simplified Chinese
验题 "modifiers" {
    测试 "stable" 标签 "fast" {
        断言 真
    }

    测试 "flaky guard" 重复 3 {
        断言 真
    }

    测试 "not written yet" 预期 "waiting on the parser" {
        断言 真
    }
}
faber convert --to zh-Hant — Traditional Chinese
測試規格 "modifiers" {
    測試 "stable" 標籤 "fast" {
        斷言 真
    }

    測試 "flaky guard" 重複 3 {
        斷言 真
    }

    測試 "not written yet" 預期 "waiting on the parser" {
        斷言 真
    }
}
faber convert --to vi — Vietnamese
đối_tượng_kiểm_thử "modifiers" {
    kiểm_thử "stable" nhãn "fast" {
        khẳng_định đúng
    }

    kiểm_thử "flaky guard" lặp_lại 3 {
        khẳng_định đúng
    }

    kiểm_thử "not written yet" việc_cần_làm "waiting on the parser" {
        khẳng_định đúng
    }
}
faber convert --to ar — Arabic
مختبر "modifiers" {
    اختبر "stable" وسم "fast" {
        أكد صواب
    }

    اختبر "flaky guard" معاد 3 {
        أكد صواب
    }

    اختبر "not written yet" مستقبلي "waiting on the parser" {
        أكد صواب
    }
}
faber convert --to hi — Hindi
परीक्षणसमूह "modifiers" {
    परीक्षण "stable" टैग "fast" {
        पुष्टि सत्य
    }

    परीक्षण "flaky guard" पुनरावृत्ति 3 {
        पुष्टि सत्य
    }

    परीक्षण "not written yet" लंबित "waiting on the parser" {
        पुष्टि सत्य
    }
}
ModifierMeaning
tag "<name>"Label for selection and filtering
repeat <n>Run the test n times — catches flakiness
todo "<reason>"Expected-pending; documents why it does not run yet
skipSkip

repeat is a test modifier, not a loop. For loops see Loops.

Asserting#

assert takes any boolean expression.

freader locale
faber convert --to en — English reader surface
describe "assertiones" {
    test "comparisons" {
        assert 1 + 1 ≡ 2
        assert 3 ≻ 2
        assert "abc".length() ≡ 3
    }
}
faber convert --to la — canonical Faber
probandum "assertiones" {
    proba "comparisons" {
        adfirma 1 + 1 ≡ 2
        adfirma 3 ≻ 2
        adfirma "abc".longitudo() ≡ 3
    }
}
faber convert --to th-TH — Thai
ทดสอบชุด "assertiones" {
    ทดสอบ "comparisons" {
        ยืนยัน 1 + 1 ≡ 2
        ยืนยัน 3 ≻ 2
        ยืนยัน "abc".ความยาว() ≡ 3
    }
}
faber convert --to zh-Hans — Simplified Chinese
验题 "assertiones" {
    测试 "comparisons" {
        断言 1 + 1 ≡ 2
        断言 3 ≻ 2
        断言 "abc".长度() ≡ 3
    }
}
faber convert --to zh-Hant — Traditional Chinese
測試規格 "assertiones" {
    測試 "comparisons" {
        斷言 1 + 1 ≡ 2
        斷言 3 ≻ 2
        斷言 "abc".長度() ≡ 3
    }
}
faber convert --to vi — Vietnamese
đối_tượng_kiểm_thử "assertiones" {
    kiểm_thử "comparisons" {
        khẳng_định 1 + 1 ≡ 2
        khẳng_định 3 ≻ 2
        khẳng_định "abc".độ_dài() ≡ 3
    }
}
faber convert --to ar — Arabic
مختبر "assertiones" {
    اختبر "comparisons" {
        أكد 1 + 1 ≡ 2
        أكد 3 ≻ 2
        أكد "abc".طول() ≡ 3
    }
}
faber convert --to hi — Hindi
परीक्षणसमूह "assertiones" {
    परीक्षण "comparisons" {
        पुष्टि 1 + 1 ≡ 2
        पुष्टि 3 ≻ 2
        पुष्टि "abc".लंबाई() ≡ 3
    }
}

Where tests live, and running them#

Tests let beside the code they exercise, inside the package. Run them with:

faber test <package>
